basic_details.short_information: The Department of Neurology, Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is filling 2 contract posts of Project Research Scientist 1 (Non-Medical) in an ICMR-funded stroke telerehabilitation project. The pay is Rs.56,000 + 20% HRA = Rs.67,200/- for a likely one year, extendable up to three years. The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy or Nursing with a Postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline, Public Health or other allied health/rehabilitation-related fields. qualification.details: Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy or Nursing, with Postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline, Public Health or other allied health/rehabilitation-related fields from a recognised university/institution.

how_to_apply: Print the application format (REC-03) attached to the notice on A4 paper and fill it in with block letters using a blue pen.
Affix a recent passport size photo on the form (do not staple).
Attach the CV and supporting documents. All certificates must be self-attested and attached in the order of the form's checklist.
Scan the form, CV and documents into one PDF and name it "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application".
Email the PDF to [email protected], writing the name of the post applied for in the subject line.
Send it so that it reaches by 5 PM on 18.11.2026.
To apply for two or more different posts, a separate application form must be filled in for each post and sent with the enclosures in separate emails.
Proof of Identity (copy of Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving License).
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate).
Degrees/Diplomas, with self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards.
Experience certificates, and proof of prior research experience, if any.
Proof of SC/ST/OBC status, if the applicant belongs to these categories.
Any other relevant documents, specified by the applicant.

The form also asks for details of previous employment, a description of experience in up to 500 words, willingness to travel to the field or other centres for the study, contact details of previous employers, and a signed declaration.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. The person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time. content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research scientist 1 (non-medical) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)

Co-design and implementation of a multidisciplinary stroke telerehabilitation package at a tertiary care centre in South India: A Hybrid Type II effectiveness implementation quasi-experimental study - The STROKE teleREHAB trial (Rehabilitation Enhancement for Holistic After-stroke Betterment)
Likely one year (extended up to three years based on satisfactory performance of the candidate)
Not exceeding 35 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy or Nursing, with Postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline, Public Health or other allied health/rehabilitation-related fields from a recognised university/institution. Experience in clinical research, preferably in stroke, neurological disorders or rehabilitation. Experience in coordinating clinical trials, interventional studies or other clinical research projects. Experience in functional assessment, disability assessment and rehabilitation outcome measurements. Publications in peer-reviewed journals; ability to converse in Tamil fluently. Proficiency in SPSS/STATA/R and data management software (Epicollect/REDCap). Not exceeding 35 years, as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. The notice says the post is not being considered for an extramural project PhD in future. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.56,000 + 20% HRA = Rs.67,200/-. The consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities beyond it will be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research scientist 1 (non-medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate day to day project activities in consultation with the Principal Investigator. Coordinate screening, recruitment, enrolment and follow-up of stroke survivors and caregivers. Assist in obtaining informed consent and maintaining participant documentation. Coordinate formative research activities, including interviews, focus group discussions and stakeholder consultations. Facilitate co-design workshops with healthcare professionals, stroke survivors and caregivers. Coordinate the development, refinement and pilot testing of the telerehabilitation package. Facilitate coordination between participants, caregivers and the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team. Support patient and caregiver onboarding to the digital telerehabilitation platform. Monitor participant engagement, session attendance, adherence and caregiver participation. Coordinate baseline and follow-up assessments and data collection. Maintain research databases and ensure data completeness, accuracy and confidentiality. Monitor intervention implementation fidelity and document indicators. Assist in quantitative and qualitative data management, analysis and interpretation. Assist the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilisation reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted based on the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection is based on CV, application, and written test/interview. After evaluation of the application form, the process is a written test followed by an interview. The written test is at 9:00 AM and the interview is from 2:00 PM onwards, for candidates who qualify in the written test. Both are on 30 November 2026 at the Seminar Room (Near Neurology Office), Department of Neurology, JIPMER Puducherry. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. Topics for evaluation: basic knowledge of stroke and post-stroke rehabilitation, principles of telerehabilitation, research methodology, clinical research coordination, participant recruitment and informed consent, data collection and management, digital health platforms, implementation research, monitoring and evaluation, and basic statistical analysis.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Project Research scientist 1 (non-medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for the post of Project Research scientist 1 (non-medical) in the ICMR-funded stroke telerehabilitation project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for sending complete applications by email is 5 PM on 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy or Nursing, with Postgraduate degree in the relevant discipline, Public Health or other allied health/rehabilitation-related fields from a recognised university/institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.56,000 + 20% HRA = Rs.67,200/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The 20% HRA is already part of the Rs.67,200/- figure. The notice says no other allowance or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form with CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF, to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are evaluated first, then there is a written test and an interview. The final selection is based on CV, application, and written test/interview.

faq.question: Q9. When are the written test and interview?
faq.answer: Both are on 30 November 2026 at the Seminar Room (Near Neurology Office), Department of Neurology, JIPMER Puducherry. The written test is at 9:00 AM and the interview from 2:00 PM onwards.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract post for an externally sponsored project, with a likely duration of one year, extendable up to three years based on satisfactory performance. It gives no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.
